contribution.position: My reliability position is unchanged. The perf report records a 3.4% error rate at peak load against a 1% budget. The incident log shows two sev2 incidents last quarter, both from retry storms. Token refresh is a path where errors trigger client retries, so an elevated error rate at peak matches the condition behind those incidents. The QA turn cites 0.4%, but the perf report says 3.4%. That figure needs reconciling before it can offset my concern, for example by confirming it comes from a different load profile or a different run. The passing functional tests (412 passed, 0 failed) do not cover behavior under load. The reliability axis would shift if the peak-load error rate is shown to be within budget, or if the retry and backoff behavior is shown to stay safe at the measured error rate.
